subject: Request: Provisional pin for Hawk-XL variant + rollback runbook
messages:
From: Hank Park <hank@novaforge.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Novaforge Partner Intake <partner_intake@novaforge.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hawk-XL onboarding: tokenizer oddities and request for temporary pin

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Attached is a short compatibility report from our infra team showing that Hawk-XL (v1.2.0) deviates on two tokenizer edge-cases for languages with right-to-left punctuation. The model runs fine in most cases but we saw a ~0.8% tokenization mismatch on a small internal test set which affects prefix-caching across multi-turn sessions.

We need to go live with Novaforge's integration next week; asking if Redwood can provisionally pin the current serving variant for their account and enable a restricted canary while we finalize a tokenizer normalization patch. The critical asks:
- Provisional variant pin for 72 hours (no auto-roll) for the customer’s environment only
- Canary (5% traffic) to track tokenization and latency regressions in our telemetry
- A rollback runbook / contact list if we see regressions

Attaching the report and a short fallback suggestion. Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Hank Park
Head of Integrations, Novaforge AI

Attachment: hawk-xl-compat-report.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Hank Park <hank@novaforge.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hawk-XL onboarding: tokenizer oddities and request for temporary pin

Laura / Marissa — looping you in for intake + release control. Repro steps are summarized in Hank's report. Quick context: this is a customer-specific integration (Novaforge) with an upcoming go-live next Wed. They hit a tokenizer mismatch that manifests for a narrow class of multilingual prefixes; the runtime can still serve but prefix-caching yields inconsistent KV hits across versions.

Proposed internal asks:
1) Temp pin: allow account-scoped pin for Hawk-XL v1.2.0 (provisional 72h) — prevents our autopromotion mechanics from swapping variant hashes for that account.
2) Canary: route 5% of Novaforge traffic to a canary variant with tokenizer-normalization shim (instrumented). Need Mina to confirm what telemetry metrics we should gate on (token mismatch rate, cache-hit ratio, p50/p95 latency).
3) Rollback/runbook: Marissa, can you provide the minimal rollback steps and the required approvals for a customer-scoped emergency rollback? We should include contact points and an automated abort if token mismatch > 0.5% for 30m.

Constraints / notes:
- We must avoid a global pin that blocks other customers. This has to be scoped to the Novaforge account.
- If Security needs artifacts (SCA, reproducible test), request them now; I've attached the fallback note from Novaforge.

Action items (please reply with owners and ETA):
- Laura: intake + model gating decision (ETA EOD)
- Marissa: provisional rollback/runbook + approval path (ETA EOD)
- Mina: telemetry gating metrics and dashboard link (ETA +2 business days)
- Aditya: runtime compatibility check for KV cache invariants (ETA +1 business day)

If we can approve a 72h provisional pin today I can communicate timelines back to Novaforge.

—Karthik
Staff PM, Model Intake & Integration
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Hank Park <hank@novaforge.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hawk-XL onboarding: tokenizer oddities and request for temporary pin

Thanks Karthik — noted. I'm OK with a customer-scoped provisional pin for 72 hours provided we follow a strict checklist and have the rollback automation ready. Proposed checklist for approval:
- Intake review complete (I reviewed the attached PDF quickly; we'll add the test vectors to the intake record)
- Telemetry dashboards created and saved as a bookmark (Mina)
- Rollback automation stub in place (Marissa / Runtime) — documented steps + on-call contacts
- Security confirmation (we'll ask security for a quick SCA and confirm there are no new surface-level vulnerabilities)

I'll own the intake gating decision and will push an approval if the above are satisfied by EOD.

One small change request on the runtime side: Aditya, can you confirm whether a customer-scoped pin can be expressed as a route-level single-variant policy (i.e., without a full account-level overlay)? If not, we prefer route-level to reduce blast radius.

Laura
Principal Product Manager, Model Intake
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Sep 30, 2027 at 09:04 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Laura / Marissa — looping you in for intake + release control. Repro steps are summarized in Hank's report. Quick context: this is a customer-specific integration (Novaforge) with an upcoming go-live next Wed...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Hank Park <hank@novaforge.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hawk-XL onboarding: tokenizer oddities and request for temporary pin

All — thumbs up from release to proceed with a provisional, account-scoped pin for Hawk-XL v1.2.0 under these constraints: 72 hours max; route-level override if Aditya confirms it's possible; automatic rollback trigger on token-mismatch > 0.5% sustained for 30 minutes; and a manual unblock workflow for longer holds (exec approval required).

I'll publish a minimal rollback runbook (file: hawk-xl-quick-fallback.md) and create a short runbook page in Confluence. Aditya — please confirm the technical feasibility of a route-level pin by EOD tomorrow; if not feasible we will fallback to an account-scoped overlay with tighter telemetry gates. Mina — once your dashboard is ready, add the watchlist and give me the link so I can add the abort automation rule.

Karthik — I'll mark the intake as provisionally approved and will notify Hank once the gating pieces are in place.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Release Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: hawk-xl-quick-fallback.md
